- Windows 11: the dark grey sheet that could cover the see-through glass of the main app is gone: the look is worked out again every time Pulse comes back (it kept an out-of-date one until a setting was changed). The background is always black; the Black / Dark grey choice is removed.
- Keyboard: a swipe down closes the keyboard on every layout (number pad, gamepad, key sets), and a swipe that starts on the number row or the number pad's 1 2 3 no longer counts as a long press.
